newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Adsteam looks at float or issue - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Adsteam looks at float or issue - paper.

text.p: The Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd has appointed brokers to advise on either a A$150 million equity raising or a float of its Adsteam Marine business, The Sydney Morning Herald reported on Friday.
"Adsteam will spin off Adsteam Marine in a public float or keep the business and have a A$150 million rights issue to refinance the parent," the newspaper said.
"If it does the latter, it would sell all other assets and return to its century-old roots as a steamship operator," the newspaper said.
"The second option would mean the resurrection of the former Adelaide Steamship Company with its only operations being marine towage, ships agency and major ship salvage," it said.
Adsteam had appointed BZW Australia and SBC Warburg as advisers, the newspaper said.

Adsteam reported a net loss of A$20.99 million in the year to June 30, 1996, down from a loss of A$23.24 million the previous year. It has operated with the agreement of its bank lenders, who were owed A$799.1 million at the end of 1995, down from A$6.07 billion at the end of 1991.
